_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.108

Deflation reports now distinguish requested and observed rates even when a
descent finishes slowly. Read trial events and standalone firmware commands;
show the source and leave unverified requests unknown. Preserve all raw data.
No controller, calibration, safety or time alignment change.

Validation: requested4mmHg/s versus actual3mmHg/s regression, firmware/GUI
command parsing, missing evidence, existing helpers and analyzer checks.
